title: Added-Name Orders on Multi-Domain Certificates
content:
**Support desk service entry — SSL/TLS Certificates: added-name orders on multi-domain certificates**

## 1. Scope

1.1 Apart from complimentary names, names are added to an SSL/TLS Certificates subscription one name to an order, and each such order is billed as its own added-name charge.

1.2 No name is added on the subscription end date itself.

1.3 The account holder pays an added name personally at Harborline's secure checkout, by a card or PayPal account entered there, once the agent has quoted the charge. Where the holder chooses account credit and the credit balance covers the whole charge, the account's credit run books the added name and it is not booked under this entry.

## 2. When the charge is fixed

2.1 The added-name charge is fixed only after the subscription's billing carries every auto-renew charge that has fallen due on it.

2.2 The added-name charge is fixed only after the subscription carries every complimentary name owed on it.

2.3 Until the subscription's records show both of those states, the added-name charge is not fixed.

## 3. What an added-name order books

An added-name order books one added-names line in the certificate billing history — one name added, covering today to the subscription end date, paid by the card or PayPal account the holder entered at checkout, under a newly issued Harborline order number — and raises the subscription's count of extra names by one. The new name takes effect on the certificate's next free reissue, which the order itself does not record.

## 4. Invocation: `add_certificate_name_7df48eab`

**Situation of use and capability.** The tool adds one further name to a multi-domain certificate subscription and bills the quoted charge for it at checkout, as set out in clause 3. The amount passed is billed exactly as given.

**How it is invoked.** This is the account holder's own tool. The agent unlocks `add_certificate_name_7df48eab` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it at Harborline's secure checkout.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `certificate_id` | the reference number of the certificate subscription receiving the name, as the agent reads it out from the certificate subscription lookup | text id |
| `checkout_method` | how the holder pays at checkout | `card` when the holder enters a payment card at checkout; `paypal` when the holder pays with a PayPal account at checkout |
| `amount` | the charge quoted by the agent | USD, 2 decimal places, signed, positive for this charge; further decimals are rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the new added-names line's reference number, the order number (HL- followed by 8 digits), the amount billed in US dollars with two decimals, the payment method recorded (card or paypal), the covered period as two YYYY-MM-DD dates and the subscription's new count of extra names. The presence of the new name count means the name was added. The tool returns an error instead when the amount is not a positive dollar figure ("Error: the charge must be a positive dollar figure."), when the payment method is neither card nor paypal ("Error: checkout_method must be card or paypal."), or when no certificate subscription has the reference given ("Error: no certificate subscription …").
